svg.text: MySQL to Riak: limited downtime, data loss not
allowed; the application itself kept both stores in
sync; MySQL stayed source of truth until trusted
workable if only one of them writes at a time
(simple switchover); hard if requests can reach
either, for example during a canary
Pattern: synchronize data in application: duplicate schemas first (Fig 4-16), give fast fallback; shared writers risk mistakes
A shared database for a strangler migration is only a very short-term measure.
